dispatch.correction: Initial in-progress interpretation selected named flex_dash_fpga_poe_dc_present at0x482e0, which checks bytes4 AND5. Following the actual Arata vtable selection corrects this to bytes4 AND1. Do not force byte5 based on the generic callback.
dispatch.prior_override: The successful earlier override set only bytes0/1. Byte4 stayed real and zero, which is sufficient to keep this Arata presence gate closed. Runtime use of this newly analyzed library still needs fresh hash/map confirmation.

native_read_path.register_read_helper: 0x87b20 dispatches controller index to its configured I2C address and PSE bus.
native_read_path.cpu_read_callback: m14er_poe_mode_from_cpu_i2c_vft at0x1f5458 relocates to0xa42a4. It formats /dev/i2c-%d from bus argument, opens O_RDWR, sets address with ioctl0x0706 (I2C_SLAVE_FORCE), calls i2c_smbus_read_byte_data, closes and propagates errors as -1.
native_read_path.proposed_reader_difference: Use native i2cget without -f; refuse a kernel-owned address rather than reproducing the driver force ioctl. No bus scan or data-register write.
native_read_path.identity_register: Native init reads byte register0x1b. Value0x45 selects the Si3470A version/firmware branch; this alone is not proof of a functioning PoE rail.
native_read_path.voltage: No validated Arata bulk PoE-input voltage register or conversion established. The ID/version read does not measure 53–54 V.

startup_side_effects.sequence: After presence success, native init invokes enable, reset release, 50ms wait and operating-state checks at registers0x10/0x15, then conditionally invokes initialization and registers its internal poe CLI.
startup_side_effects.arata_enable: Callback0xa47b0 calls dash_fpga_poe_power_ctrl(1) for ARATA121; this is an actual hardware-control path.
startup_side_effects.reset: Native callback flex_dash_fpga_poe_reset at0x4845c uses dash_fpga_pse_reset_status / dash_fpga_pse_reset; not invoked in this review.
startup_side_effects.firmware: Initialization at0x88618 reads chip identity, then versions. For0x45, it opens /firmware/Si3470A_FW_2_0_19.bin, compares the header and conditionally calls updater0x8909c. Other branches can call the same updater. The updater issues register writes and transfers firmware bytes. RAM-vs-nonvolatile persistence is not established.
startup_side_effects.decision: Do not equate full startup/presence spoof with a read-only diagnostic. Identify a responding controller before selecting any enable/reset or firmware-changing experiment; full native init is not selected now.

internal_cli.registration: nim_l2ether_cli_register("poe", "poe", callback0x88010) occurs only after the presence/enable path. The read branch at0x882f8–0x8836c calls the register helper.
internal_cli.syntax: poe <ifnum> r <reg>, decimal ifnum / hexadecimal reg
internal_cli.limits: Outer IOS transport and live registration are not established. Do not paste this as an IOS EXEC command or substitute the known-crashing test platform hardware poe get 0 global.

planned_live_sequence: Obtain current owner physical-state/console confirmation, rediscover the serial device, verify both aliases free, and capture fresh A identity/readiness. No duplicate recovery permission is needed.

Confirm live libmirabilesw.so / libcmlib_ngio.so / 8M-2xSFP+.yml / i2cget hashes and native consumer mapping. Resolve /sys/class/i2c-adapter/i2c-2 name/device/of_node and device-tree alias mapping without I2C transactions.

Use an existing qualified Linux maintenance shell if required. ROMMON is a route to a temporary maintenance boot, not an established dedicated PoE diagnostic. Preserve original A4/BOOT and package bytes.

Only after runtime bus/target confirmation and no address ownership conflict, make a single SMBus byte-data read of0x1b at each configured address. Candidate command: /usr/sbin/i2cget -y 2 0x20 0x1b b; then0x21. No -f, broad scans, reset, power enable or automatic initialization.

If identity matches the native0x45 path, read0x41/0x43/0x76 at the responding address and compare with the bundled version. Any mismatch/no ACK stops automatic progression; no firmware update follows.

A response supports controller communication and can justify investigation of detection/initialization and a documented voltage channel. No response leaves power/reset/routing/population unresolved; it does not prove absent hardware.
If maintenance boot was needed, restore/read back original boot settings and verify normal modules/power/port baseline before closing the console.
